# Roadmap

_`Status` is each milestone's **current** delivery status, derived from krill's append-only `milestone_status_event` history (`store.MilestoneStatusEventStore.CurrentStatuses`). A milestone with no recorded transition is `not started` — that is krill's own derivation from the absence of history, not a rendered default._

4 milestones (0 abandoned), one block each below.

### M1 — Community members keep using `/wai` and the music poll on an FCM the operator can deploy and debug from accurate docs, with manman V1 gone

- Status: in progress
- Delivers: C1, C2, C3, C4, C13, C14
- Must not foreclose: LB1, LB2, LB3
- Deliberately deferred: manmanv2 server status in Slack (C7) (→ M2); generic notifications that any service can use (C6) (→ M2); whagent_net-backed multi-turn AI conversations (C8) (→ M3); controlling manmanv2 servers from Slack (C9) (→ Later); an agent asking a human a question and receiving the answer back in its own workflow (C10) (→ Later); a service registering a slash command that FCM routes to it (C11) (→ Later); the Slack AI assistant taking actions in other monorepo systems (C12) (→ Later)
- Ships alongside: Removal of every manman V1 dependency (server-control actions/shortcuts/modal, `/test`, the V1 subscribe service, `//generated/py/manman:*` deps); Removal of dead code (commented-out tasks, `SayHello`, deprecated direct-Gemini path, `MyClass` scaffold); ARCHITECTURE.md / ENV.md / README.md / docs/* rewritten to match the code; `slackspecialchannel` tables kept through the V1 removal (LB1 route table)
- FR budget: 12

This is an onboarding milestone: existing behavior only, no new user-facing features.

### M2 — A community member sees manmanv2 server status in Slack, delivered through a notification path any service can use

- Status: not started
- Delivers: C6, C7
- Must not foreclose: LB1
- Deliberately deferred: whagent_net-backed multi-turn AI conversations (C8) (→ M3); controlling manmanv2 servers from Slack (C9) (→ Later); an agent asking a human a question and receiving the answer back in its own workflow (C10) (→ Later); a service registering a slash command that FCM routes to it (C11) (→ Later); the Slack AI assistant taking actions in other monorepo systems (C12) (→ Later)
- FR budget: 12

### M3 — A community member can hold a multi-turn AI conversation in Slack run by whagent_net

- Status: partially complete
- Delivers: C8
- Must not foreclose: LB2, LB3
- Deliberately deferred: controlling manmanv2 servers from Slack (C9) (→ Later); an agent asking a human a question and receiving the answer back in its own workflow (C10) (→ Later); a service registering a slash command that FCM routes to it (C11) (→ Later); the Slack AI assistant taking actions in other monorepo systems (C12) (→ Later)
- FR budget: 12

### M4 — A community member can run an ad-hoc Simple Poll-style poll in any channel FCM is in, with every vote stored

- Status: shipped
- Delivers: C5
- Must not foreclose: LB1, LB3
- Deliberately deferred: picking a different channel from the /wpoll creation form (→ Later); scheduled auto-close and deadlines for /wpoll (→ Later); editing or adding poll options after a poll is posted (→ Later); per-option custom emoji on /wpoll (→ Later); results export or charts for /wpoll (→ Later); recurring polls (→ Later); controlling manmanv2 servers from Slack (C9) (→ Later); an agent asking a human a question and receiving the answer back in its own workflow (C10) (→ Later); a service registering a slash command that FCM routes to it (C11) (→ Later); the Slack AI assistant taking actions in other monorepo systems (C12) (→ Later)
- Ships alongside: `poll`, `polloption`, `pollvote` tables (votes are never deleted; un-voting stamps `removed_at`); docs/poll.md; `/wpoll` registered in the Slack app config
- FR budget: 8

Independent of M1–M3: it needs no V1 removal, no service contract, and no whagent_net. It can ship before M1 closes; M1's "no new user-facing features" scope is unchanged.

Must not foreclose:
- LB1: C10 may later render an agent's question as a poll, so a poll is keyed by its own ID and Slack message ts, not by a producer route.
- LB3: votes are recorded by the voter's Slack user ID, never FCM's.

## Later coverage

_Capabilities no milestone delivers, with the load-bearing decisions recorded as protecting them (krill `lb_protects_feature` edges). A capability with none is uncovered._

- C9 — A community member can start, stop, or restart a manmanv2 server from Slack.: LB3 — So that manmanv2 can authorize the person rather than FCM.
- C10 — An agent can ask a human a question in Slack and receive the answer back in its own workflow.: LB1 (Needs LB1's correlation ID and reply route.), LB3 (Needs LB3 for who answered.)
- C11 — A service can register a slash command or interaction that FCM routes to it.: LB1 — Needs LB1's correlation ID and reply route.
- C12 — A community member can have the Slack AI assistant take actions in other monorepo systems through whagent_net tools.: LB2 (Tools live in whagent_net.), LB3 (Actions carry the Slack user as the on-behalf-of subject.)
